name: Innocent Incest
source:
A few years after "END END SUMMER".
They started as an awkward family, but gradually grew closer.

The protagonist, who had been living abroad with Akito, is suddenly told that she will be returning to Japan. Immersed in the days like she was in a boxed garden, the protagonist cannot honestly rejoice in her homecoming...

The cherry blossom season.
The protagonist's environment changes drastically upon returning home.

A nostalgic childhood friend.
A classmate with a beautiful face who sits next to her.
Akito's friend, a school counselor.
A girl and her boyfriend who dream of making movies as part of their club activities.

She gradually becomes accustomed to her unfamiliar school life, but Akito remains the center of her world. She continues to seek Akito with the single-mindedness of a child, but Akito gradually begins to avoid her.

Then comes another summer.
Akito tells the protagonist a definitive goodbye.

[Translated from [url=http://meltself.web.fc2.com/i2/story.html]official website[/url]]
